strings.subtitle: — Fayili tiɲɛla —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Dɔɔni ni bila tɛ se ka kɛ. Baara nin bɔtɔn min bɛ duguma la.
strings.ssd_warning:
Kɔlɔsili! SSD kan, sɛbɛnni kɔnɔ na mɛn bɛ se ka tiɲɛ da, TRIM kosɔn.
Nin pɔrɔgaramu bɛ HDD ye.
strings.confirm_text:
Fayili "{name}" bɛna sɛbɛn a kɔnɔ ani bɔ.

Taa ɲɛ?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAYILI SƐBƐNNA A KƆNƆ ANI BƆRA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS kunnafoni wɛrɛw (ADS) tɛ baara kɛ.
• USN gafe tɛ saniya.
• Dibikun nɔgɔ ani sankɔrɔ kunnafoniw
  (OneDrive ani wɛrɛw) tɛ se ka kɛ.
strings.status_full: A kɔnɔfɛnw sɛbɛnna a kɔnɔ fu fɛ. Seginni tɛ se ka kɛ — minɛnw bɛna fu dɔrɔn ye.
strings.status_fast: Kun, kɔrɔ ani 4 MB jiriliw sɛbɛnna a kɔnɔ. Dɔɔnin ma maga, nka faraw kosɔn, fayili bɛɛ seginni ni sanfɛ minɛnw tɛ se ka kɛ. Gundolamɔgɔ sɛbɛnw ye, CƐMANKƐ baara.
strings.status_empty: Fayili tun fu lo, sɛbɛnni a kɔnɔ tun ma kan. Bɔra.
strings.error_permission: N tɛ se ka don fayili la. A bɛ se ka kɛ pɔrɔgaramu wɛrɛ kɔnɔ. Da a la ani a jɛ a la kokura.
strings.error_not_found: Fayili ma sɔrɔ. A bɛ se ka kɛ a bɔra joona.
strings.error_is_symlink: Nin ye jirili ja ye. Jiriliw tɛ se ka tiɲɛ — fayili taabolo bɛna kɛ a ka ɲi.
strings.error_reparse: Nin ye fayili sigiyɔrɔ (OneDrive walima a nɔgɔ). A kunnafoni bɛ sankɔrɔ la, tɛ disiki kan — fɛn tɛ yen min bɛ se ka tiɲɛ.
strings.error_not_file: Nin tɛ fayili ye (dosiyɛ walima fɛn wɛrɛ). Fayili bila.
strings.error_hardlinks: Nin fayili bɛ jirili gɛrɛw fɛ ({n} bɛɛ). Jirili gɛrɛw tɛ kun fɛ — tɔgɔ bɛɛ man kan. Ni i tiɲɛna sira nin na, kunnafoni bɛna sɛbɛn a kɔnɔ ani a tigɛ 32 byte ma, nka a tɔlɔ bɛna se ka sɔrɔ jirili wɛrɛw fɛ. Bɔ jirili bɛɛ fɔlɔ.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayili kunna, dogoya walima fan. Sɛbɛnni a kɔnɔ fu fɛ tɛ se ka tiɲɛ kunnafoni kɔrɔw da, NTFS bɛ a mara sira wɛrɛ fɛ.

Bɔ a jirili: numanboli → Jiriliw → Ɲɛmɔgɔ → bɔ a jirili "Kun" ani/"Dogoya". O kɔ, SHREDDER baara kokura.
